title: Write a Liquid Filter | Orchard Core
description:
The filters that come with Orchard Core do not cover every need of a site, and a template can only call the filters that are registered for its tenant.

A module registers its own filters when the tenant starts: a delegate for a filter without dependencies, or a class that implements ILiquidFilter for a filter that needs services. Both are available in every Liquid template of the tenant.

In this video:
• How a filter is called, and where filters are registered
• A filter in one line, with a delegate registered with AddFilter
• A filter that needs services, with a class that implements ILiquidFilter
• What a filter returns: encoding, nil and the immutable options
• Using the filters in a template for the About page
• More from the same builder: values, converters, member access and tags
